# DFT-D4 charge-scaling data: the element-specific chemical hardnesses of
# equation 2.
#
# Source: the global atomic hardnesses of Ghosh and Islam, Int. J. Quantum
# Chem. 110 (2010) 1206-1213, the paper's ref 42, as the dftd4 distribution
# carries them (github.com/dftd4/dftd4, licensed LGPL-3.0-or-later by its
# per-file SPDX headers; the data module chemical_hardness), the same
# distribution and notice row as the D4 reference-state table.  Values only:
# no statement, comment or structure of that module is reproduced.
#
# Machine-extracted, and extracted twice by two independent readers with
# zero disagreements.  The module tabulates 118 elements; the parameterized
# range this library covers is Z = 1..86, and only that range is carried.
#
